'''047582''' was an accident report regarding an incident on Level 10, Sector D, in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Morjanssik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. The malfunction of an environmental control unit released toxic gas into the area; it was not detected until the worker shift change. The gas [[Death/Legends|killed]] five workers and incapacitated ten more. Medical staff [[M-04-37|expressed concern]] that later effects could still manifest themselves, and [[S-04-18|reported]] to security that they were doubtful that the gas could have been generated randomly by the malfunction of the control unit. A [[Q-04-1005|requisition]] was placed for a new environment control unit.
